text: 法国债券市场本周经历了历史性动荡。随着政治局势不安可能进一步加剧市场对该国公共财政的担忧，一项备受关注的风险指标正接近有记录以来最大升幅。数据显示，本周迄今，投资者持有法国10年期国债而非德国同期限国债所要求的风险溢价已上升33个基点，为1990年有记录以来最大升幅。
text_en: The French bond market experienced historic turmoil this week. As political instability may further intensify market concerns about the country's public finances, a closely watched risk indicator is approaching its largest increase on record. Data showed that so far this week, the risk premium investors demand to hold French 10-year government bonds rather than German bonds of the same maturity has risen 33 basis points, the largest increase since records began in 1990.
